title: A Comparison of Surgical Preparations and Wound Infection Rates for Elective Cesarean Sections
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to find out if chlorhexidine gluconate solution is better at reducing the rate of wound infection after cesarean section compared to povidone-iodine.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Age \>19 years
* Gestational age \> 37 weeks
* Booked elective cesarean section

Exclusion Criteria:

* Gestational age \< 37 weeks
* Premature rupture of membranes
* Onset of labor prior to procedure
* Evidence of maternal sepsis; maternal fever \> 38.5C
* LSCS for emergency issues: non-reassuring fetal status, placental abruption, failed induction
